outcome: Prevalence of Enterococcus faecalis and staphylococci colonization
Antibiotic resistance profiles of E. faecalis and staphylococci isolates
cohort: 150 healthy Saudi neonates born in a hospital setting in central Saudi Arabia
finding: Enterococcus faecalis colonization did not significantly vary in relation to type of delivery, age up to 7 days, and type of feeding.
mod_finding: Enterococcus faecalis colonization was relatively higher among vaginally versus cesarean delivery.
